title: Paper boat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Water waves -->
  <path d="M5 78 Q15 72 25 78 Q35 84 45 78 Q55 72 65 78 Q75 84 85 78 Q92 74 96 76" fill="none" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M5 86 Q15 80 25 86 Q35 92 45 86 Q55 80 65 86 Q75 92 85 86 Q92 82 96 84" fill="none" stroke="#29B6F6" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Boat hull (main body) -->
  <path d="M18 62 L82 62 L70 78 L30 78 Z" fill="#FFB74D" stroke="#FF8F00" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Hull highlight band -->
  <path d="M24 66 L76 66 L72 72 L28 72 Z" fill="#FFCC80"/>

  <!-- Left sail (triangle) -->
  <path d="M42 62 L42 28 L22 62 Z" fill="#FFE082" stroke="#FFC107" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Left sail fold/shade -->
  <path d="M42 28 L42 62 L32 62 Z" fill="#FFD54F"/>

  <!-- Right sail (triangle) -->
  <path d="M46 62 L46 32 L68 62 Z" fill="#FFF9C4" stroke="#FFC107" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right sail shade -->
  <path d="M46 32 L46 62 L56 62 Z" fill="#FFE082"/>

  <!-- Mast line -->
  <line x1="44" y1="26" x2="44" y2="62" stroke="#E65100" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on hull -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="67" r="2.5" fill="#5D4037"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="67" r="2.5" fill="#5D4037"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="66" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="66" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 71 Q49 77 58 71" fill="none" stroke="#5D4037" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="71" r="2.5" fill="#FFAB91" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="71" r="2.5" fill="#FFAB91" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
